title: Young Boy Wearing Sombrero, 1955 B&W Suburban Snapshot Photo
description: A 1955 black-and-white snapshot featuring a young boy named Cary standing in a residential backyard. He is wearing a wide-brimmed Mexican sombrero, a white short-sleeved shirt, and dark trousers. Behind him are brick suburban homes, utility wires, and a T-shaped clothesline pole, capturing a classic scene of mid-20th-century post-war American childhood. The border features scalloped edges with a margin date stamp reading 'MAY • 55'.
